items.title: Accusing wife of adultery for speaking to male friend is cruelty: Jharkhand High Court
items.summary: The Jharkhand High Court recently observed that accusing one's wife of adultery for merely speaking to her male friend amounts to mental cruelty. A Bench of Chief Justice MS Sonak and Justice Manoj Prasad made the observation while dismissing a man’s plea seeking divorce from his wife. One of the allegations made by the husband was that his wife was in an extra-marital relationship as she used to talk to an unknown male over mobile phone. “To our considered view, such allegations are typical gender-based stereotypes, where, if a woman talks to a man, even if he is a friend, charges of adultery or of an extramarital relationship are levelled. We are, therefore, of the considered view that such allegations amount to cruelty towards the wife,” the Court said. In 2021, the husband moved a family court seeking dissolution of marriage, alleging that his wife was not interested in the marital relationship.
